statement:
by
  classical
  exact let ch := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length≤2; ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T≤X → (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n : ℕ => n%6=4 ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, ch p ∧ ch q ∧ p+q=n ∧ (p+2).Coprime (q+2)))).card:ℝ)≤C*(X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 要求两个陈素数的移位数 p+2 与 q+2 互素，仍有幂节省例外界。
plain_statement.en: Remove shared prime factors between the two Chen shifts.

brief.zh: 公共因子必整除 n+4。估计这些素因子对应的坏表示上界，再与双陈筛下界比较；需控制整除 n+4 的大因子。
brief.en: A shared divisor divides n+4. Subtract representations carrying its prime divisors from a two-sided lower bound.
